title: Implement panelized GF(p) PLE/LU — small-prime family (026fc832 Phase 6)
description:
Phase 6 implementation task under epic `026fc832`. Implements the panelized GF(p) PLE/LU kernel per the design in `2e8c5a29`.

Parent epic: `026fc832`. Predecessor: `2e8c5a29` (design), `40195c09` (lift).

## Amendment (2026-05-26, user-approved, session 9 + session 10)

R0 (commits `a238ef36..6607005d`) closed 10/22 cells PASS. R1 recursive PLUQ (commits `dbe33877..da092c66`) closed 4 of 6 GF(251) PLE cells:
- GF(251)/64 uniform: 2.16× → 1.21× (PASS)
- GF(251)/64 deficient: 2.46× → 1.37× (PASS)
- GF(251)/256 uniform: 4.36× → 2.35× (SHORTFALL — amended [aspirational] below)
- GF(251)/256 deficient: 4.60× → 2.38× (SHORTFALL — amended [aspirational] below)
- GF(251)/1024 uniform: 2.89× → 1.37× (PASS)
- GF(251)/1024 deficient: 2.96× → 1.42× (PASS)

**Session 10 user decision:**
- **GF(251)/n=256 cells (2 cells)** — amended `[aspirational]` against the measured 2.35× / 2.38× ceiling. Per R1 worker's structural analysis (`dev/bench_results/2026-05-26-6823c8a0-r1-recursive-pluq.md` § "Residual SHORTFALL analysis"), the n=256 panel kernel is per-pivot row-major axpy-bound at ~4 Gop/s; closing requires a blocked Schur-update kernel or float-cascade PLE — out of 6823c8a0 scope. No new follow-up filed.
- **GF(65521) cells (4 cells, deferred earlier session 9)** — deferred to follow-up task `68db401b` (Phase 6d, u16-lane PLE base-case kernel).

**Amended SC#4 reads:** "Every A8 pluq cell either PASSes (ratio ≤ 1.5× vs fflas) OR carries an explicit user-approved [aspirational] amendment OR is closed by a named follow-up. (a) GF(251)/n=256 uniform + deficient: [aspirational] at observed 2.35× / 2.38× — closure requires blocked Schur-update kernel or float-cascade PLE (no follow-up filed; pursue if/when 026fc832 successor epic prioritises). (b) GF(65521) PLE cells: deferred to `68db401b` (Phase 6d) — not required for 6823c8a0 closure."

Original SC#4 preserved in **Original Success Criteria** subsection below for audit. All other SCs remain `[hard]` and are verified for closure.

## Background

Implements the design approved under `2e8c5a29`. Closes A8 rows 6-17, 71 (pluq cells over GF(7/251/65521) and GF(31)).

## Success Criteria (current — amended 2026-05-26)

- [hard] Production code implementing the panelized PLE per the approved design at `dev/active/2e8c5a29-panelized-ple-design.md`.
- [hard] Bit-exact correctness vs the existing scalar PLE on a proptest sweep across GF(7), GF(31), GF(127), GF(241), GF(251), GF(65521) at boundary lengths {0, 1, 15, 16, 17, 63, 64, 65} plus rank-deficient cases. Uses `proptest!` macros.
- [hard] 5-trial CCX1-pinned benchmarks on the 5900X reference host at n in {64, 256, 1024} for each of the 6 small primes, both uniform and rank-deficient regimes. Recorded as CSV + evidence doc.
- [hard] [AMENDED 2026-05-26 — see Amendment block above] Every A8 pluq cell either PASSes (ratio ≤ 1.5× vs fflas) OR carries an explicit user-approved [aspirational] amendment OR is closed by a named follow-up. GF(251)/n=256 cells are [aspirational] at observed 2.35× / 2.38×; GF(65521) PLE cells are deferred to `68db401b` (Phase 6d).
- [hard] No regression on currently-PASSing GF(p) cells (delta ≤ 5%).
- [hard] No `unsafe` outside `gf2-kernels-simd` / `gf2-kernels-hip`. `gf2-core` remains `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`.
- [hard] Reuses the SSOT helpers named in the design (`barrett_reduce_lane32`, panel size constants).

## Original Success Criteria (pre-amendment, preserved for audit)

- [hard] Every A8 pluq cell (rows 6-17, 71) either PASSes (ratio ≤ 1.5× vs fflas) or carries an explicit user-approved [aspirational] amendment. Escalate cells that don't cross the threshold.

## Out of scope

- Echelon/invert/solve implementations (sibling tasks; depend on this).
- Mersenne31 PLE (not in scope of the design).
- GF(65521) PLE cells (deferred to `68db401b` per the 2026-05-26 amendment).
- GF(251)/n=256 PLE cells (amended `[aspirational]` 2026-05-26 — closure deferred indefinitely unless a successor epic prioritises blocked Schur-update or float-cascade PLE).

## Notes

- R0 dispatch (session 9, 2026-05-26) closed 10/22 cells PASS. Evidence at `dev/bench_results/2026-05-26-6823c8a0-panelized-ple.md`.
- R1 dispatch (session 10, 2026-05-26) added recursive PLUQ and closed 4 of 6 GF(251) cells. Evidence at `dev/bench_results/2026-05-26-6823c8a0-r1-recursive-pluq.md`.
- Wave 7b (echelon/invert/solve) depends on this issue closing.
